set.request: ext/tabs: the filling promise in Page.prototype.tabs has no .catch() — a throwing child content() leaves the tab bar blank with no console trace. Fix minimally, update docs, verify on the live dev server, prove with a scratch throwing child.
steps: fix filling promise with attributable error
prove fix with scratch throwing child, then delete it
set.outcome: **Fixed the uncaught rejection in ext/tabs' filling promise.** `Page.prototype.tabs()` in public/framework/ext/tabs/tabs.js now ends the fill chain with `.catch(error => console.error(`${this.log_label()}.tabs() failed to fill:`, error))`. Diagnosis: on cold boot the rejection was already being caught by App.instantiate()'s try/catch (via App.loaded()'s Promise.all) but at the cost of wiping the whole app into a Page Load Error screen; on every later navigation it was a true unhandled rejection with zero attribution, since Router.load() never awaits app.loaders again. The fix makes filling always resolve, logs the failure tagged with the page's url on both paths, and updates doc/method/tabs.md and doc/file/tabs.js.md accordingly. Verified via Playwright against the live dev server on /framework/ext/tabs/, /framework/core/View/, /framework/core/Page/ (bars render, zero console errors) and proved with a scratch throwing child (now logs cleanly, scratch file deleted).
